tools.name: search_kaio_businesses
tools.description:
Find businesses that can be booked online with Kaio. `what`: the kind of business or treatment
    ("estetista", "pulizia viso", "idraulico"); `where`: town, province or area ("Lecco", "Brianza").
    Returns name, slug, address, Google rating, website, booking link and services with prices.

tools.name: get_kaio_business
tools.description:
A Kaio business by its slug (from search_kaio_businesses): description, timezone, booking link
    and services with their ids, duration and price — the ids are what kaio_free_slots and booking need.

tools.name: kaio_free_slots
tools.description:
Real free times of a Kaio business for one service (id from get_kaio_business), dates YYYY-MM-DD,
    at most a couple of weeks at a time. These are the same slots its booking page shows.

tools.name: book_kaio_appointment
tools.description:
Book an appointment at a Kaio business. `start_time` is one of the slots from kaio_free_slots
    (ISO 8601 with offset). A phone or an email is required: the business uses it to confirm and remind.
    Only call this after the person has confirmed business, service, day, time and contact details.
